_note: What the canary checks on the LIVE site. These ship deliberately loose, because a brand new shelf with no picks and nothing for sale is a perfectly normal state and must not go red on day one. Tighten them once your shelf is real: that is where the value is.
_tighten: Set games.min and games.max around your real count, and set the three minimums to numbers you would want to be told about losing. SETUP.md step 6 walks through it.
_freshness: maxAgeHours is only enforced once config.js names a sheet. The shipped demo shelf has a fixed build date on purpose.
